description: Drop the admin-only `platformFeatureFlags` field from every generated selection (me, userTermsUpdate, workspacePolicyDeploySourceAllowlistAdd.addedBy). Railway CLI login-session (browserless / `railway login`) tokens cannot read it, and Railway rejects the ENTIRE query with a blanket `Not Authorized` (HTTP 200 + errors[]), breaking workspace resolution via `me`. No consumer of the field exists.

patches.value:
query me {
  me {
    agreedFairUse
    apiTokenRateLimit {
      remainingPoints
      resetsAt
    }
    avatar
    banReason
    createdAt
    email
    featureFlags
    flags
    githubProviderId
    githubUsername
    has2FA
    hasPasskeys
    id
    isAdmin
    isConductor
    isVerified
    lastLogin
    name
    profile {
      bio
      isPublic
      website
    }
    registrationStatus
    riskLevel
    termsAgreedOn
    username
    workspace {
      adoptionLevel
      allowDeprecatedRegions
      avatar
      banReason
      createdAt
      discordRole
      has2FAEnforcement
      hasAutomaticDiagnosis
      hasGuardrailsAccess
      hasHipaaBAA
      hasSAML
      id
      name
      plan
      preferredRegion
      redactedDueTo2FAPending
      slackChannelId
      subscriptionModel
      subscriptionPlanLimit
      supportTierOverride
      updatedAt
      usersWithout2FA
    }
    workspaces {
      adoptionLevel
      allowDeprecatedRegions
      avatar
      banReason
      createdAt
      discordRole
      has2FAEnforcement
      hasAutomaticDiagnosis
      hasGuardrailsAccess
      hasHipaaBAA
      hasSAML
      id
      name
      plan
      preferredRegion
      redactedDueTo2FAPending
      slackChannelId
      subscriptionModel
      subscriptionPlanLimit
      supportTierOverride
      updatedAt
      usersWithout2FA
    }
  }
}
